Proposition

↗ cor:5-30

1. ch7:7.11An embedded submanifold $H\subseteq G$ that is a subgroup is a Lie subgroup.

Proof

\sketch Restrict multiplication and inversion on $G$ to $H$. Their images lie in $H$ by the subgroup property, and the embedded-submanifold smoothness criterion (Corollary cor:5-30) makes the restricted maps smooth into $H$.

□
